The '''Warden's Holocron''' contained the [[Gatekeeper/Legends|gatekeeper]] of a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], forged to defend the [[Dawn Temple]] on [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. [[Gender/Legends|She]] appeared in [[Color/Legends|golden]] light, [[Armor/Legends|armored]] and stern, with a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at her side. Unlike the [[Curator (Dawn Temple)|Curator]] or the [[Jailor (Dawn Temple)|Jailor]], she cared little for philosophy or archives. Her duty was to train in combat, oversee the Temple's defenses, and protect its inhabitants against any threat, whether from outside or within.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

When the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] collapsed and the Temple fell into ruin, the Warden remained at her post. Though her fellow [[Holocron/Legends|holocrons]] were lost, she endured as an unyielding sentinel, bound to her role by duty. To those who found her later, she seemed severe and demanding, judging worth only through action. Yet she never wavered in her purpose: to safeguard the secrets of the Dawn Temple and await those who might restore its light.<ref name="Lure of the Lost" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Warden's Holocron first appeared in ''[[Lure of the Lost]]'', a downloadable adventure for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny]]'' [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]].
